editorial:
Imagine waking up in a hospital bed with no idea how you got there, only to find out the world outside has gone completely crazy. You follow a young woman who is slowly piecing together the nightmare of an aggressive virus outbreak. The vibe is very tense and scary, making you feel the same confusion and panic as the main character. Since this is a short film, it does not waste any time getting into the action. It sets up a world where the rules have changed and you never know who to trust, which keeps you on the edge of your seat the entire time.

The acting feels real and the pacing is quick, which is great for a prequel. One of the best parts is how it builds up to the reveal that the cure might actually be worse than the sickness itself. While it is short, it does a great job of making you want to see the full story. If you love quick scares and mystery, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: The movie ends with a scary realization about the virus and the medicine. As the woman learns more about her situation, you see that the people who were supposed to be cured are not actually okay. The twist is that the treatment doesn't just fix the virus, it changes the people into something much more dangerous. It leaves you hanging right as the real horror starts, perfectly setting up the events for the full movie.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves quick horror stories and virus outbreaks.
